meta_description:
27K likes, 150 comments - nvidia on October 23, 2026: "Our CEO Jensen Huang met the next generation of Al builders in Astana.

At @alem.ai_, he spent time with students and startups and joined Deputy Prime Minister @zhaslanmadiyev to discuss Kazakhstan’s Al future.

Jensen’s visit comes as Firebird Al and Kazakhtelecom expand NVIDIA-powered computing infrastructure, with Firebird planning a Kazakhstan lab to help local startups and researchers build on it.

See what’s taking shape in Kazakhstan at the link in bio.".
